final: WITH telescope_rates AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_rate FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), first_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS baseline FROM telescope_rates), first_kept AS (SELECT tr.telescref, tr.avg_rate FROM telescope_rates tr CROSS JOIN first_baseline b WHERE tr.avg_rate > b.baseline), second_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS baseline FROM first_kept), final_kept AS (SELECT fk.avg_rate FROM first_kept fk CROSS JOIN second_baseline b WHERE fk.avg_rate > b.baseline) SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(avg_rate - (SELECT baseline FROM first_baseline)) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(avg_rate - (SELECT baseline FROM second_baseline)) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM final_kept
